data.body:
FINAL /rebar-debug REPORT — c0b9 (patchset landed for review as Gerrit change 2449)

ROOT CAUSE (proven): `src/rebar/config.py::reconciler_repo_root()` returned `Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]` as the reconciler's default repo root when `REBAR_ROOT` was unset. That expression is the checkout ONLY under an editable install (package inside the checkout). Under a non-editable/wheel install the package lives in site-packages, so `parents[2]` climbs to `<venv>/lib/pythonX` — no `.git`, no `src/rebar` — and the reconciler silently reconciled the wrong tree. Production sets `REBAR_ROOT` so it never bit there; the `test_reconcile_main.py` non-editable leg exposed it (observed: "Resolved repo_root .../.venv/lib/python3.13").

DISCRIMINATING PROOF: with `REBAR_ROOT` unset and the package NOT inside a checkout, TODAY the function returns a non-checkout venv path; AFTER Option C it raises the clear error (non-checkout CWD) or returns the checkout (validated CWD toplevel). The RED oracle was proven RED for the right reason, held out from the fixer, and mutation-checked.

FIX — Option C (validated layered fallback): 1) `REBAR_ROOT` verbatim; 2) package root IF `_is_repo_checkout`; 3) cwd git-toplevel IF `_is_repo_checkout`; 4) else raise naming both `REBAR_ROOT` and `--repo-root`. `_is_repo_checkout` = `.git` entry + `src/rebar` dir. `_git_toplevel_of_cwd` runs a bounded (`timeout=10`) `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, degrading to None on any failure so step 4's clear error surfaces. Behavior-preserving for the two cases that work today (REBAR_ROOT set; editable install).

DEFECT ORIGIN / caused_by: `ba8b-c728-8c62-48e9`, class `plan_defect` (recorded on the pending close). git-blame followed the `parents[N]` fallback through its carrier moves (reconciler `__main__.py` `parents[4]` → `config.py` `parents[2]`) to the commit that introduced the package-location fallback as the DEFAULT; ticket recovered from its `rebar-ticket:` trailer. The original resolver design assumed an editable install; a reviewer could have caught the non-editable case.

STEP-7 SIBLING SWEEP: found two confirmed siblings — `fetcher.py:507` and `:626` (`Path(repo_root_env() or Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4])`), same class — now routed through `reconciler_repo_root()`. `__main__.py:52` `_pkg_parent = ...parents[3]` is NOT a sibling (sys.path bootstrap of the package parent, never binds repo_root) — sanctioned, not changed. CLASS DRAIN: added `scripts/check_repo_root_from_package.py`, an AST guard wired into `make lint` that fails CI on any new package-location `Path(__file__).parents[N]` root-climb under `src/` (design detail in the preceding comment). Sibling of the existing `check_repo_root_from_tracker.py` guard that drained the `dirname(<store>)` spelling.

CALLER SWEEP / SAFETY: `reconciler_repo_root()` callers unchanged in signature and in the two working cases; this is a restoration of correct behavior (adds validation + a fourth error branch), not a new API. No new dependencies (`subprocess` is stdlib). No test-weakening: the RED oracle was added, mutation-checked, and held out; the superseded brittle regex construct-test was removed in favor of the AST guard (a stronger, non-source-text check).

eb64 COORDINATION: verified epic eb64 (`financial-stoneware-brant`) is NOT rethreading repo-root resolution — it converges the operation-snapshot boundary; the reconciler still resolves repo_root via `config.reconciler_repo_root()`. No path conflict (fix site is top-level `config.py`, outside eb64's declared paths). Rebased cleanly onto current origin/main; gates re-run green. → proceeded and landed (NOT deferred, unlike siblings 73d8/ce6b which defer for the llm/ scope).

REPLICATION: reproduced the wrong-path return at runtime under a simulated non-editable layout before the fix; after the fix the same scenario raises the clear error (non-checkout CWD) or returns the validated checkout.

GATES: `make lint` (ruff check + format-check + complexity ratchet new=0/increased=0 + module-size + both repo-root guards + env-registry) and `make typecheck` (mypy, 719 files) both PASS on the worktree venv. `config.py` stays under the 800-LOC cap; no function trips the mccabe ceiling.

RESIDUAL RISK: (a) the AST guard's two-statement escape (`p = Path(__file__).resolve(); p.parents[2]`) is not caught — accepted, matches the tracker-guard precedent and no such site exists. (b) `_git_toplevel_of_cwd` depends on `git` on PATH; absence degrades to the clear step-4 error, not a wrong path. (c) a daemon launched from an arbitrary non-checkout CWD with `REBAR_ROOT` unset now errors clearly instead of silently reconciling the wrong tree — the intended behavior change.

LANDING: patchset pushed to Gerrit change 2449 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2449). Ticket remains `in_progress` per Gerrit policy — close awaits `Verified +1` (CI) AND `LLM-Review +1` (re-review triggered by this patchset). Close will record `--class=plan_defect --caused-by=ba8b-c728-8c62-48e9`.
